item.title: Zverev beats Shelton to win US Open 2026 and second Grand Slam title
item.description:
Let’s get the obvious part out of the way immediately: This stinks. Ben Shelton had a chance to end a 23-year Grand Slam drought for American men’s tennis on Sunday afternoon in New York. Instead, Alexander Zverev beat him 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 to win the U.S. Open and capture his second Grand Slam title of the year. American men’s tennis missed a golden opportunity , but Shelton gave America a tennis star worth rooting for. It's not the same as winning, but it's a major positive step for a country desperate to find the next great American player. Shelton, making his first career Grand Slam final appearance, looked nervous from the start. The first game told us exactly what kind of afternoon this might be. item.title: Baghdad confirms attack on Saudi pipeline came from Iraq
item.description:

The pipeline had provided a workaround for Saudi crude, allowing the kingdom to bypass the Strait of Hormuz; its shuttering threatens the loss of 4% of the global oil supply, Reuters reported.
